_comment: Quest templates. QuestSystem instantiates these, resolving 'any' targets into concrete systems/ruins so every playthrough differs. Objective types: scanSystem | scanBody | collectResource | analyzeArtifact | discoverRuin | landOnPlanet | travelTo | reachReputation | researchTech | discoverCiv | defeatHostiles | scanAnomaly | returnTo | talkTo.

quests.title: First Survey Contract
quests.description: Commander Vance wants proof you can do the job: survey an uncharted system in the Spur and bring back resources.

objectives.desc: Jump to an uncharted system in the Orion Spur
Recover 40 iron (mine asteroids or planetary nodes)
Return to the Concord and report

quests.title: Signal Beneath the Regolith
quests.description: Your survey caught an energy signature on a terrestrial world. The Concord wants it investigated before someone else claims it.

objectives.desc: Travel to the system containing the ruin signature
Recover and analyse at least one artifact

quests.title: The Glyphs Will Not Sit Still
quests.description: The artifact's inscriptions resist translation. The Concord suspects the language encodes a date. Build the capability to read it.

quests.title: Spire-House Survey Contract
quests.description: The Vherrathi will pay in precursor alloy for a full survey of Perseus Arm systems - and they want ruin dates, not just positions.

objectives.desc: Survey three systems in the Perseus Arm

quests.title: The Last Voice
quests.description: The Veshari reliquary holds the only complete record of the Vanishing. The Vherrathi have its region. Go and read it.

objectives.desc: Travel to a system with ruins in the Perseus Arm

quests.title: Songs and Stones
quests.description: The Kelthari will trade their deepest memory of the age before for archaeological records they cannot dig up themselves.

objectives.desc: Analyse three artifacts of any origin

quests.title: The Vault That Emptied Itself
quests.description: Something has been emptying sealed reliquaries from the inside. Find out what - and whether it is still doing it.

quests.title: Salvage Run
quests.description: The Remnant marks ruins; you dig them out; everyone profits and nobody files paperwork.

quests.title: The Vanishing
quests.description: The Concord will fund anything that produces a working theory of the Vanishing. That means evidence, not opinions.

quests.title: The Question
quests.description: Something has left a recording addressed to your ship. It knows your registry. It is waiting for an answer.

objectives.desc: Travel to an Unknown Anomalous Region

quests.title: Clearing the Lane
quests.description: Pirates have been hitting survey ships on the Kepler lane. The Concord pays per hull destroyed.

quests.title: The Long Missing
quests.description: A derelict survey ship, missing for sixty years, has started broadcasting again. Its last log entry is nine seconds long and contains a voice that is not on the crew manifest.

quests.title: Hydrogen on Credit
quests.description: A Concord logistics clerk will cover your next long hop if you top up the Spur's hydrogen reserve. Distance is the difficulty; fuel is the invoice.

quests.title: What the Ashen Would Not Leave
quests.description: The Ashen Remnant want a wreck in contested space stripped before the Vherrathi claim it as a trophy. Bring back what still remembers them.

objectives.desc: Return the salvage to the Remnant
